feedback_by_option.fil: Unahin ang kaligtasan at agarang tulong.
Maaaring makapinsala ang shortcut: Huwag magbigay ng diagnosis, maghintay ng lahat ng senyales, o magpainom sa batang hindi ligtas lumunok.
feedback_by_option.en: The shortcut can cause harm: Do not label the illness, wait for every sign, or give anything by mouth to a child who cannot safely swallow.

feedback_by_option.fil: Ang shortcut ay hindi ligtas: Huwag magbigay ng diagnosis, maghintay ng lahat ng senyales, o magpainom sa batang hindi ligtas lumunok.
feedback_by_option.en: The shortcut is unsafe: Do not label the illness, wait for every sign, or give anything by mouth to a child who cannot safely swallow.

feedback_by_option.fil: Obserbahan ang gawa at ang tamang referral.
feedback_by_option.en: Observe the task and appropriate referral.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi batayan ang kuwento para sa sariling diagnosis.
feedback_by_option.en: The story is not grounds for an independent diagnosis.
